subject: Spike notice — quick 15m to review recent usage and next steps

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Chen <alex@brightpath.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Spike notice — quick 15m to review recent usage and next steps

Hi Alex —

I noticed BrightPath hit a notable token spike this morning on your self-serve project (project id: bp-prod-4). Congrats on getting heavy usage — that’s the best kind of problem to have.

If you have 15 minutes, I’d love to review the spike (likely pattern, e.g., batch jobs or ramping users), share a couple of cost/latency optimizations we commonly suggest, and quickly show how a 15m config change could lower per-token cost without affecting latency. No sales pitch — just practical routing/batching suggestions and a short walkthrough.

Here are a few 15m slots I have this week:
- Fri 5/28 11:30am PT
- Mon 5/31 10:00am PT
- Mon 5/31 2:00pm PT

Or you can pick a time that works for you: https://calendly.com/soojin-lee/15min

I’ve attached a one-pager agenda and a quick troubleshooting checklist that Ben (cc’d) and our CS partner Monica can refer to if helpful. If you’d prefer Ben join for a short kernel/throughput conversation we can add him.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0117
